title: Existence of normalized actual-restriction scalar models
statement:
For every scheme X, the normalized scalar-model type of [def-sp-finite-free-direct-image-data] is inhabited. This constructs the actual restriction adjunction and both multiplication units, with all displayed normalization equations.

theorem finiteFreeDirectImageScalarModels (X : Scheme.{u}) : Nonempty (ScalarModel X)

source.place: Tags 03EK, 06YY and 07A6; construction of multiplication-normalized scalar models.

proof.text: Obtain presentations p and normalized family n from successive_derived_quotient_normalization. Lift the isomorphism between the two exact-restriction factorizations along Qh and transport each n.adjunction along it. Naturality of the lifted comparison and its factorization give the actual-restriction unit normalization.

For identity coefficients ordinary restriction is the identity. Use leftAdjointIdIso to identify the ordinary scalar extension with identity. Tensor balancing rewrites r tensor x as 1 tensor rx; the normalized ordinary unit and the triangle identity show that the counit maps this to rx. The ordinary identity extension is exact; thus its universal derived counit is invertible. Lift that counit followed by the ordinary multiplication unit along Qh. The localization factorization gives exactly unit_normalization.
